Where We Work

Install My Kitchen is based in Coundon, Coventry, and covers the whole of Coventry and Warwickshire — including Rugby, Nuneaton, Leamington Spa, Kenilworth, Warwick, Solihull and Stratford-upon-Avon — as well as Berkshire towns including Reading, Bracknell, Slough, Maidenhead, Windsor, Wokingham, Newbury and Ascot. If you are unsure whether we cover your area, just ask — we regularly take on installations a short distance beyond these areas.

We fit kitchens from every major retailer — Wren, Howdens, Magnet, IKEA, B&Q, Wickes, Benchmarx and more — and also handle repairs and remedial work such as hinge, door and worktop replacements. For anything installation-related, the quickest route is a £195 pre-installation survey, credited back in full when you book your installation.

Phone is the fastest way to reach us — call 07399 651836 between 8am and 6pm, Monday to Saturday. Emails and form enquiries are answered within one working day. If you already have a kitchen delivery date booked, let us know in your message so we can prioritise available installation slots around it.
